subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Break the ice

options.text: To talk about something that is considered taboo
To begin a conversation to relieve the tension in an uncomfortable situation

solution: The correct answer is **'Option 2'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • 'Break the ice' refers to doing something to create a more relaxed and comfortable social situation, especially at the start of a social event where people meet for the first time. The English meaning is to relieve social awkwardness or tension (माहौल को आरामदायक बनाना). • **Example: **Telling a little joke is a good way to break the ice at the start of a speech. • 'To begin a conversation to relieve the tension in an uncomfortable situation', which is the correct answer, means taking the initiative to ease an awkward or tense atmosphere by starting a dialogue. Its English meaning is to commence a dialogue to alleviate an uneasy circumstance (एक असुविधाजनक परिस्थिति में तनाव को कम करने के लिए बातचीत शुरू करना). • **Example: **He started to talk about his travel adventures to begin a conversation and relieve the tension in the room. Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 2'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • 'To talk about something that is considered taboo' means discussing something that is generally avoided or not talked about because it is socially unacceptable (तब्बू मानी जाने वाली किसी चीज़ के बारे में बात करना). • 'To discuss something worthless' means to engage in a conversation about something that has no value or importance (नकारात्मक चीज़ के बारे में बातचीत करना). • 'To reveal a secret' means to divulge or expose something secret or not known by many people (एक रहस्य खोलना). 71:Taf7, "The correct answer is **'Option 4'**
